scoring_justification: Lattice constants, band energies, and λ are compared to paper-reported values with tolerances; Tc is recomputed from the agent's own λ to verify correct formula application.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for lattice constants, band energies, λ, and Tc parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II for lattice constants (GGA+U, U=1eV); main text and supplement for approximate band energies; main text for λ ≈ 0.45; Tc formula parameters from main text (θ_D=280 K, μ*=0.12).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken directly from the paper; McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula applied to compute expected Tc from the paper's λ (yielding 1.19 K, consistent with ~1 K stated in paper).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers appear in the paper or are standard formula evaluations; no synthetic labels or hold-out data are used.

schema.description: Two whitespace-separated numbers: a and c in Å, each to at least 4 decimal places.

outputs.description: Optimized lattice constants of LaRu3Si2 after DFT+U relaxation.

flat_band_energy.description: Energy of the kagome flat band relative to the Fermi level

dirac_point_energy.description: Energy of the Dirac point at K relative to the Fermi level

van_hove_energy.description: Energy of the van Hove singularity near M relative to the Fermi level

outputs.description: Energies of the flat band, Dirac point, and van Hove point from the electronic band structure.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the electron-phonon coupling constant λ.
A single floating-point number representing the superconducting critical temperature Tc in Kelvin.

outputs.description: Superconducting critical temperature estimated from McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are numerical and deterministic for the given DFT+U protocol. The checker will compare submitted values to the paper's reported values within appropriate tolerances (not disclosed here). The phonon_band.dat is process evidence, not scored.
